hooks.command: p=$(sed -n 's/.*"file_path"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -1 | tr '\\' '/' | tr -s '/'); case "$p" in */backend/vendor/*) : ;; */backend/*.php) docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/compose.dev.yaml exec -T app vendor/bin/pint "${p#*/backend/}" 2>/dev/null || true ;; esac
